detached_structure.evidence: The central house has an attached lower-roof section at the southwest corner that looks like a garage or addition, not a separate building. The small gray-roofed shed to the northeast belongs to the neighboring lot.

signals.notes: The central house is heavily shaded by mature trees, with dense canopy to the west and east that hides much of the yard. Its dark gray roof is partly shadowed, so its condition is hard to judge, and the lot has no visible driveway access.
